full_name: Mary Beth Saffo | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Mary Beth Saffo is a research associate at the Museum of Comparative Zoology at Harvard University and adjunct scientist at the Marine Biological Laboratory at Woods Hole.
